entries.risk_area: Voice-activity & speech injection permission policy bypass
entries.evidence: Verified PermissionPolicy risk-level classification, voice-approvable guards, sensitive file path checks, protected folder safeguards, and screen-only restrictions for undescribable/network commands.
Verified filtering of ANTHROPIC_*, CLAUDE_CODE_*, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, NODE_OPTIONS, and TLS override environment variables when spawning child CLI processes.

entries.risk_area: Remote phone link pairing & frame encryption
entries.evidence: Verified HKDF-SHA256 key derivation, ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD framing with strict sequence number checks against replay, constant-time proof comparisons, and 128-bit random pairing offer secrets.
Verified secure storage of Anthropic API keys in macOS Keychain using kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlocked and proper Keychain query attributes.

entries.risk_area: Sensitive information disclosure in diagnostic logs
entries.evidence: Verified regex-based scrubbing of API keys, GitHub/AWS tokens, Bearer tokens, emails, home directory paths, and usernames before log writing or diagnostic export.

entries.risk_area: Dynamic urllib file scheme / SSRF injection
entries.evidence: The script is an offline developer build tool. All urllib requests use hardcoded https://huggingface.co/ URL prefixes with regex-validated path and commit segments (SEGMENT, COMMIT, DIGEST patterns), ruling out arbitrary file:// access or SSRF.
